description: 한국 여행 안내·관광 통계 (Korea Basics): Describe Korea Basics and list what it covers: entry and customs rules, places and curated collections, photo sets and live views, visitor statistics, dates, practical travel tools, lodging licence lookup, and what the user can do on the site (open places in map apps, save to My Korea, add dates to a calendar).
